title: GM Jeremy's Critical Hit Dice
description: Custom Critical Hit, Fumble and Hit Location dice, plus a classic multicolor polyhedral set, with 3D support through Dice So Nice!. Roll with /crit, /fumble and /location, or the formulas 1dh, 1du and 1db. A Sever Limb critical rolls Hit Location automatically.

recommends.reason: Shows the dice as 3D rolls on the table.
